news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.2% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Earnings have declined by 41% per year over the past 5 years. Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (8.2% average weekly change). Profit margins are more than 30% low

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹16.78 (vs ₹23.35 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹16.78 (down from ₹23.35 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹6.05b (up 11% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹53.7m (down 28% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.9% (down from 1.4% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 1% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 15% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹19.02 (vs ₹19.44 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹19.02 (down from ₹19.44 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹6.18b (up 43% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹60.9m (down 2.2% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.0% (down from 1.4% in 2Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 23% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 4% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.
